meta.title: QCS ranking shows all bidders as “Knocked Out” after conversion to auction (RCA 318540007159)
gaps: Verify that the selected event was specifically converted from an RFQ lot with historical savings not copied.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the selected event was specifically converted from an RFQ lot with historical savings not copied.

steps.note: Open an existing bid event, relying on the runner to select the fitting converted-auction event because no event title or ID was provided.
